elan_i2chid_tools: Elan Tools for Auto-Update (AU) This patch is for Elan tools for Auto-Update: elan_i2chid_iap and elan_i2chid_read_fwid. The first tool is a firmware update tool for i2chid device. The second tool is a firmware ID lookup tool with configuration file. This tool is used to get the firmware ID and find an appropriate FW. Its configuration file may need to be updated if panels changed. These two binary tools are installed to /usr/sbin. The configuration file is installed to /usr/share/elan_i2chid_tools. Command: (Take INX panel for example, HID PID: 0x2a03) Read FWID: (root) ./i2chid_read_fwid -P 2a03 -f fwid_mapping_table.txt -s chrome -q FW Update: (root) ./i2chid_iap_v2 -P 2a03 -f firmware.bin -q BUG=b:128880259 TEST=on Elan Touchscreen, read firmware ID, update firmware, and touchscreen works. Change-Id: I4a44cebc659d5d4986ac6315357edfd90081d92e Signed-off-by: Paul Liang <paul.liang@emc.com.tw> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1617060 Tested-by: Karen Chou <karen.chou@elan.corp-partner.google.com> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Trent Begin <tbegin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Crag.Wang <crag_wang@dell.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org>

The prestart log is sent to syslog.
